lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. Centroids in the mid-flank region display higher intensity and larger diameter than those on the dorsal or ventral margins.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a rectilinear grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots that lack the grid-like alignment observed on the lateral flank.
